payload.title: hr-service never derives a workforce scope from the caller: list reads are scoped only when the client sends moduleCode, and reads by id or employeeId (employee, employeeCertifications, performanceReviews) return any employee of the tenant to any caller who passes the role gate
evidence: apps/hr-service/src/common/module-scope.ts:15 (an absent module means no scope: the Company view, every module)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/dto/employee-filter.input.ts:24-30 (moduleCode is an optional client filter, the only scope employees gets)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/query-handlers/get-employees.handler.ts:30-32 (the scope is applied only when the client sent moduleCode)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/query-handlers/get-employee.handler.ts:19-21 (employee(id) loads any employee of the tenant)
apps/hr-service/src/training/training.resolver.ts:143-151 (employeeCertifications(employeeId): no role gate and no scope)
payload.rule_violated: D5 (a module manager sees only their slice) and contract rule C2 (module arguments only narrow a scope the server derives).
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-07, release R4.
